description: The file is a shell script used as a Git hook for controlling access to branches and tags during push operations. It implements policies for enforcing fast-forward updates, restricting overwriting tags, and managing user/group permissions based on configuration files.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Outputs 'grant' and exits with status 0 to allow access.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Outputs 'deny' and exits with status 1 to deny access.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs informational messages if verbose mode is enabled.
